Name: Tan & Sober Gentlemen
Address: Charleston Pour House – Main Stage, 1977 Maybank Hwy., Charleston Pour House, SC, 29412, United States
Notes: Tan and Sober Gentlemen Friday, November 27th 2026 Charleston Pour House | Deck Stage 8pm doors / 9pm show $18 Advanced / $20 Day of Show Tan and Sober Gentlemen Born and raised in North Carolina, the Tan and Sober Gentlemen began taking in the songs, stories, and tunes that make up their beloved state’s musical tradition before they could talk. The music of the Carolinas, (and Appalachia in general) stems from the marriage of the Irish fiddle and the African banjo, which first met in the American South before the Revolution. The Tan and Sober Gentlemen aim to bring these traditions full circle. They play Irish tunes, ballads, and pub songs right next to the Appalachian fiddle tunes of their youth, melding the two into what they call “Irish-American hillbilly music.” Meanwhile, they have earned a reputation as one of the South’s hardest-hitting live acts, playing at blazing tempos and putting every last bit of energy they possess into the show. The result is a raucous celebration of the Carolinas’ Irish heritage, with drinking, dancing, and merriment galore. Since their formation in 2017, the six-piece band has toured the US and Ireland, playing festivals such as MerleFest, Blue Ox Festival, IBMA Bluegrass Live!, Bristol Rhythm and Roots, Appaloosa Festival, FloydFest, Rooster Walk, Ramble Fest, Shakori Hills, Raleigh Wide Open, (US), and Electric Picnic, Spraoi, and the world’s largest festival of Irish traditional music, the Fleadh Cheoil na hÉireann (Ireland). In January of 2024, in their home of Alamance County, they sold out their show at the Haw River Ballroom, recording a live album with a crowd of 800 people. “Live at the Haw River Ballroom” was released in February 2025. They released their sophomore record, Regressive Folk Music, in June 2022, and their debut record, Veracity, was named by Shite’n’Onions as one of the five best Celtic punk records of 2019 and 2020. *By purchasing a ticket, you agree to receive emails from ARTIST and PROMOTER. *Show is 21+. Scott Baston / Bill Jarrett and special guests) * A New Lineup Every Week* Mondays Charleston Pour House | Deck Stage 5pm doors /6:30pm shows 2 x sets Lineup: Scott Baston Bill Jarrett Corey Stephens Ethan Hamlin Danny Circharo Jon Joiner The Headstrings Collective The Headstrings Collective is the latest creative project from longtime friends and collaborators Scott Baston and Bill Jarrett. Known for their years together in the beloved Southern jam band Moonshine Still (1996–2007) and later in St. Francis, Scott and Bill have spent decades weaving soulful songs and sharing stages with an array of incredible musicians across the country. With The Headstrings Collective, they bring that same spirit of collaboration, connection, and musical exploration to a new home: Monday Muse on the Charleston Pour House deck. Beginning this September, Scott and Bill will host a rotating lineup of talented musicians each week, creating a one-of-a-kind experience where no two nights are ever the same. At its core, The Headstrings Collective is about community—celebrating friendship, creativity, and the joy of live music.
